Jyaistha 12, Tuesday, Saka 1948- June 02, 2026

RAJASTHAN RAJYA VIDYUT PRASARAN NIGAM LIMITED
OFFICE OF THE ZONAL CHIEF ENGINEER (T&C-JPZ), JAIPUR
REVISED NOTIFICATION
Jaipur, April 30, 2026

Rajkaj No 21854411: In pursuance to the notification Dt. 03.10.2017& 05.11.2024 issued by
the Energy Department, Govt. of Rajasthan, Jaipur which was published in the Rajasthan
Gazette dated 09.10.2017& 08.11.2024 under the Sec.164 and 67 & 68 of the Electricity Act,
2003 respectively as well as the power of the Telegraph Authority under the provision of the
Indian Telegraph Act , 1885 (Central Act 13 of 1885) to the Zonal Chief Engineer (T&C),
Jaipur of Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Ltd. (the state Transmission utility ) to erect
electric lines/ electric plants for the transmission of electricity or for the purpose of telephonic
of telegraphic communications necessary for the proper coordination works. Hence the
undersigned to exercise of the above powers, here by accord the sanction of right of way for
“Construction work of LILO of 132 KV S/C Rajgarh-Malakhera line at 220 KV GSS
MAUJPUR” for the supply of electricity. The Notification for the said line has already been
published vide Gazette Notification, GOR, Chaitra 04, Thursday, Saka 1948- March 25, 2026,
including revenue villages and Angle Tower Location Coordinates. The revised Notification is
including both the Suspension and Angle Tower Locations Coordinates: -
